name: Papelería Construir
description: Uruguayan WooCommerce store for office and school supplies, architecture model materials, laser cutting and paper reams. Offers home delivery and free store pickup; coverage areas are not listed.
description_es: Tienda uruguaya en WooCommerce de artículos de oficina y escolares, materiales para maquetas de arquitectura, corte láser y resmas. Ofrece entrega a domicilio y retiro gratis en el local; no lista zonas de cobertura.

ships_to.notes: Home delivery is offered; the purchase guide lists no coverage areas, costs or times.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free in-store pickup stated in the purchase guide.

shopping_notes: No robots.txt could be read by the probe. A nationwide 48 hour delivery block on the homepage has a placeholder link, so it is not recorded. Currency not shown on opened pages.

sources.supports: purchase process, home delivery, free pickup
